parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

The value Account indicates the members of the resource directory.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag key. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

parameters.name: ValueFilter
parameters.description: The tag value for a fuzzy query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-tag-values --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --max-results 10 --resource-type Account --tag-key k1 --value-filter v1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --MaxResults 10 --TagKey k1 --ResourceType Account --ValueFilter v1
